modules-for-submitting-a-bundle.text: Dependency direction runs from the command line down to the shared library. The write commands and their signing call sites are not touched.

changed-responsibilities.text: The provider module (shared local-services library) gains the read that answers where a transaction sits on the chain. Every implementation answers it: the Koios provider through its transaction status call, the synthetic ledgers and the devnet facade in tests.

ownership.text: Files are read at the command boundary; the chain is read through the existing capabilities; sends use the existing bounded submission capability; nothing runs after the command; single-threaded. The command keeps no state.

not-changed.text: Fold, fold rules, preparation, the write commands and their signing call sites, --wallet-skey, the vault, the bundle format.
